method_notes: Dedicated second-pass national census of UK major business-event infrastructure, run because the first pass admitted only 22 conference/convention/exhibition venues (10 CONVENTION_CENTRE + 12 EXHIBITION_CENTRE, and CONFERENCE_CENTRE zero times). METHOD: (1) The 642 existing census records in venues.json were read programmatically and reduced to a canonical_name+city+nation+venue_type index; every candidate below was checked against that index before research, so venues already carried by other workstreams (e.g. Winter Gardens Blackpool, Venue Cymru, Westpoint Exeter, Brangwyn Hall, Caird Hall, Glasgow Royal Concert Hall, Music Hall Aberdeen, Usher Hall, Ulster Hall, Millennium Forum, Donald Gordon Theatre, The Glasshouse International Centre for Music, Brighton Dome, St George's Hall Bradford, Butterworth Hall, Bolton Arena, Silverstone Circuit) were deliberately NOT re-listed. (2) POPULATIONS ACTUALLY CHECKED, deliberately overlapping and never treated as truth on their own: Association of Event Venues full member directory (aev.org.uk/about-us/venue-members, 56 records across 6 pages, fetched); London & Partners / London Convention Bureau conference-venues directory (conventionbureau.london, all 6 pages); Unique Venues of London full member list (uniquevenuesoflondon.co.uk); Convention Edinburgh / Meeting Edinburgh searchable venue directory (meetingedinburgh.com/venues, 114 records with Max Theatre / Reception / Banqueting columns); Glasgow Life venue-hire directory (glasgowlife.org.uk/venue-hire, 3 pages); VisitScotland Business Events (businessevents.visitscotland.com - venue directory path is 404; only the conferences-and-exhibitions inspiration page carries capacities); VisitAberdeenshire business events (business.visitabdn.com - names no venues, lead-capture only); Business Events Wales / Meet in Wales (meetinwales.com - /venues is 404 and the search is client-rendered, but individual product pages carry structured capacity fields); Visit Cardiff / Meet Cardiff (meetcardiff.com/venues and /highlights/ pages); Visit Belfast business events (visitbelfastbusiness.events - client-rendered, static HTML exposes only 4 featured listings and its sitemap contains no venue pages: a genuine unswept population); NewcastleGateshead Convention Bureau; the agricultural-society / county-showground estate reached venue-by-venue from official society sites; and the official venue websites themselves, which were the primary evidence source throughout. (3) EVIDENCE RULE APPLIED: every non-null capacity_value cites the exact URL fetched that states it. Where a venue publishes only floor area, or only standing figures, or nothing, that is recorded honestly rather than guessed - six records carry capacity_value null with CAPACITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED. No coordinates were guessed; latitude/longitude are null throughout. Addresses and postcodes appear only where a fetched page stated them. (4) CALENDAR RULE APPLIED: venue-hire pages, capacity charts and floor plans were NOT recorded as calendars. Only pages listing actual named forthcoming events were recorded, and events_currently_present is true only where named forthcoming events with dates were actually seen in the fetched page. (5) CONSISTENT EXCLUSION RULE: hotel-integrated ballrooms and function suites were excluded even at 1,000+ (InterContinental London - The O2 / Arora Ballroom 3,100 theatre; JW Marriott Grosvenor House Great Room 1,300 theatre; Novotel London West Champagne Suite 1,400 theatre; Hilton Birmingham Metropole; Celtic Manor Resort Caernarfon Suite 1,200 theatre; Macdonald Aviemore Resort Osprey Arena 1,150 theatre; Prestonfield Edinburgh 1,000 theatre). These are evidenced and named in the hand-back report so the census owner can reverse that judgement in one pass. (6) LIMITATION: the session's WebSearch budget (200 calls) was exhausted partway through, so later discovery was WebFetch-only, navigating from official sites. Several sites refused automated fetches entirely (c-h-w.com, eastsiderooms.com, qub.ac.uk, swansea.gov.uk, ulster.ac.uk, visitpeterborough.com, cardiff.ac.uk) - where a figure could still be obtained it is marked with its real source grade, and where it could not, the gap is stated rather than filled.
